adjudicated_statement: Let S be a reduced locally Noetherian scheme carrying a proper smooth genus-six degree-four family satisfying (CE), (N), and (BAL), with associated fibre-degree-six line bundle L such that h^0(C_s,L_s)=3 for every geometric fibre s and L_s is base-point-free. Let pi:script-C→S be the family, let A be its relative linear system of one-dimensional spaces of sections of L, and let script-D be the universal degree-six divisor in script-C x_S A. Write Delta_script-C for the diagonal in script-C x_S script-C and pr_1,pr_2 for its projections. Then script-G:=pr_{2*}(pr_1^*L(-Delta_script-C)) is locally free of rank two on script-C and is compatible with arbitrary base change. Using the line convention for projectivization, the incidence morphism (p,Gamma)↦p identifies script-D canonically with P_script-C(script-G), hence with a Zariski-locally trivial P^1-bundle over script-C. Let U⊂A be the reduced-support locus, let Z→U be the finite étale right S_6-torsor of orderings, and put Z^(1):=script-D x_A U. Then Z^(1) is open in script-D, is finite étale of degree six over U, and is canonically Z/S_5 for the stabilizer S_5 of the first letter. If F is a Q-linear cohomological theory with transfer for free finite étale quotients, then F(Z^(1))≅F(Z)^{S_5}≅Hom_{S_6}(Ind_{S_5}^{S_6}(1),F(Z))≅M_[6](F(Z)) direct-sum M_[5,1](F(Z)), because Ind_{S_5}^{S_6}(1)≅[6] direct-sum [5,1]. Thus Z^(1) recovers the multiplicity spaces of the [6] and [5,1] isotypic summands; it is not itself their direct sum as S_6-subrepresentations. This applies, where defined, to rational ordinary, compactly supported, or Borel–Moore cohomology and their mixed Hodge structures and weight-graded pieces. It asserts neither Tate type nor control of other S_6-isotypics and does not extend to integral coefficients or functors without finite-quotient transfer.
contradiction_resolution: The mandatory originating evidence was checked first. ATT-0114, Lemmas 3.1 and 3.2 and claim CLM-0114-4, supplies the incidence-bundle and S_5-quotient arguments; REV-0161 explicitly confirms CLM-0114-4 and raises no objection to those geometric arguments. The extracted candidate nevertheless requires correction. First, its twist must use the diagonal Delta_script-C in script-C x_S script-C, not the separately used discriminant Delta in A. Second, the projectivization is over script-C. Third, the S_5-invariant statement follows independently from Z^(1)=Z/S_5, not from the projective-bundle structure. Fourth, unrestricted H^*(Z) is replaced by a Q-linear cohomological theory with transfer for free finite étale quotients: additivity and equivariance alone do not imply F(Z/S_5) congruent to F(Z)^{S_5}. Fifth, these invariants are the [6] and [5,1] multiplicity spaces, not the corresponding isotypic subobjects themselves. Public sources corroborate the reduced-base Grauert input, Zariski-local triviality of P(script-G), and the free finite étale quotient; the elementary identity Ind_{S_5}^{S_6}(1) congruent to [6] direct-sum [5,1] then gives the multiplicity-space decomposition by Frobenius reciprocity. This is consistent with FND-0130, FND-0131, FND-0134, FND-0139, FND-0157, and FND-0075. It must not be merged with FND-0152, which concerns induction from a component stabilizer H_alpha rather than the quotient Z/S_5. No claim in data/claims.jsonl contradicts the corrected result.

hypotheses: S is reduced and locally Noetherian
the genus-six family is proper and smooth over S
the representation-theoretic assertion uses Q-coefficients and a Q-linear cohomological theory having transfer for free finite étale quotients
scope.mathematical_scope: The promoted result identifies the incidence divisor as a projective bundle and identifies the S_5-invariants of transfer-compatible rational cohomology with the multiplicity spaces for [6] and [5,1]. It does not establish Tate type, control other S_6-isotypics, or apply integrally or to functors lacking finite-quotient transfer.
